candidates.title: HeatCache: Thermal-aware Energy-efficient LLM Inference Scheduling for Chassis-level Liquid Cooling in Sustainable Edge Server Rooms
candidates.reason: Recent implemented vLLM scheduler coupling inference SLOs with thermal/energy constraints on commercial liquid-cooled GPUs. It introduces heat-budget scheduling and electrical-informed heat-demand estimation and reports energy, throttling, and SLO results.

rejected_candidates.title: Large-Scale LLM Inference with Heterogeneous Workloads: Prefill-Decode Contention and Asymptotically Optimal Control
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Primarily stochastic-control/queueing theory with numerical experiments rather than a concrete implemented inference-system mechanism; lower fit than systems implementations for this survey.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Switched from MoE to an independent energy/thermal systems axis. HeatCache is a recent implemented vLLM scheduling system and was not found by repository code search; a theory-dominant contention-control paper was rejected for systems-fit reasons.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Search GPU runtime/kernel or quantization-system omissions, then perform recent-new-paper sweep for September.
